notes.title: NBA 2K25 Patch Notes v3.0, including Easy Anti-Cheat on PC.
notes.notes:
Patch Update 3.0 for PC, releasing on Steam shortly before Season 3 begins on November 29, will introduce Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC). EAC is an industry-leading service designed to combat cheating tools and other unauthorized third-party software with an evolving approach that can counter new cheating techniques. 

This implementation is part of the ongoing efforts by Visual Concepts and our Game Security team to detect and minimize cheating in NBA 2K. It works alongside existing measures, such as behavior-based bans, anti-tampering protections, and the in-game reporting system, to protect the integrity of competitive gameplay.

To help ensure a smooth transition, we recommend completing the following steps before installing Update 3.0, which will also install EAC if it’s not already present on your system:

[olist]
 Update your PC to the latest version of Windows to maintain compatibility.
 Make sure your graphics card and other essential drivers are up to date.
 Update hardware control software (e.g. RGB lighting) to its latest version to resolve potential security vulnerabilities, or disable it if a compatible version is not available.
[/olist]

After installation, you may see a message whenever you start NBA 2K25 letting you know EAC is initializing.

If you still experience issues related to EAC—such as error codes or trouble launching the game—after completing these steps, please share your feedback with us through 2K Support or our official Discord feedback channels.

Thank you for your partnership as we work to deliver a fair and more secure NBA 2K experience.

---

notes.title: NBA 2K25's New Gen version is coming to PC!
notes.notes:
Stack wins, raise banners, and make history in NBA 2K25.

The New Gen version of NBA 2K25 is now supported on PC. Powered by enhanced ProPLAY™ technology, New Gen NBA 2K25 delivers the franchise’s most true-to-life basketball experience yet, offering players the ultimate control in how they dominate the competition. Players on PC with compatible specs will now benefit from the enhanced realism of ProPLAY™ technology, and the ability to compete in modes such as MyNBA, The W and in The City.

Learn more:
General FAQ: https://2kgam.es/3Ldwsfy

PC FAQ: https://2kgam.es/3LatHvi
